¿Cara o sello? La moneda decide quién la: Heads or tails? The coin decides who throws the mingo
{team} van más cerca · {d} m del mingo: {team} are closer · {d} m from the mingo
Al gastar todas las bolas, el equipo más: When all balls are thrown, the closest team scores a point for each ball nearer the mingo than the rival's best. At equal distance, the hand scores no points.
Antes de la primera mano, una moneda dec: Before the first hand, a coin decides which team throws the mingo: heads for the reds, tails for the greens. The host can change this in More settings: random, table order, or the team that lost the last game starts.
Arrima al mingo o saca la bola rival con: Roll close to the jack or knock the rival ball away with a boche. Two teams, a dirt court and your friends in 3D.
Arrima al mingo. Si una bola rival estor: Get close to the mingo. If a rival ball is in the way, knock it out with a boche!
The host changed. The hand goes on.
Cancha de bolas criollas: toca para apun: Bolas criollas court: tap to aim. Arrows for direction; hold space and let go to throw.
El blanco indica dónde frena sin choques: The target shows where it stops with no hits. Hold and let go to set the distance.
El mingo se coloca automáticamente al co: The mingo is placed automatically when the hand starts. Get your ball as close as you can or use a low boche to knock the other balls away. In the air lets you clear a ball: set Height before charging and watch the blue landing ring. The mingo also moves when hit.
Fuerza: mantén y suelta para lanzar: Power: hold and let go to throw
Gana quien llegue a la meta elegida, 12: The first to reach the chosen target, 12 or 24 points, wins. This casual version uses a compact court, an automatic mingo, and low and in-the-air boches.
Juega el equipo que está más lejos del m: The team farther from the mingo plays. If it has no balls left, the other one plays. A distance tie alternates the throwing team.
Jugando con bots · tus panas pueden entr: Playing with bots · your friends can join by invite in an online room.
La bola va por el aire…: The ball is in the air…
La dificultad también afina a los bots r: Difficulty also tunes the rival bots: on Hard and Expert they knock away balls that stick to the mingo. Your team's bots always play on Normal.
La fuerza sube y baja; suelta para lanza: Power rises and falls; let go to throw
La línea de tiro indica dónde frenaría l: The aim line shows where the ball would stop if it hit nothing. On Easy it also shows the hits and where the balls end up; on Hard and Expert it gets shorter. Switching to a low roll adds speed: let go earlier to keep the same distance.
La sala sigue jugando mientras estás en: The room keeps playing while you're in the menu.
Las bolas que cruzan la línea quedan fue: Balls that cross the line are out. If the mingo goes out, the hand is void: nobody scores. The host opens the next hand or the rematch.
Mano nula: nadie suma. Vamos con un ming: Void hand: nobody scores. Let's go with a new mingo.
Nadie quedó más cerca: esta mano no suma: Nobody ended up closer: this hand scores no points.
Reglas de la casa: dos equipos de tres,: House rules: two teams of three, reds and greens. Each player throws two or four balls; bots fill the empty seats. Teammates take turns throwing.
Se va fuera: reduce la fuerza o cambia l: It's going out: lower the power or change direction
Solo el anfitrión lo cambia, antes de la: Only the host can change it, before the hand.
